# 262_R6FIX.12 — sign-up redirect loop hotfix (F-15 / BL-105)

**Base:** `main` · **Branch:** `stevevitali/r6fix-12-signup-loop` · **mergePolicy:** OPERATOR (this run never merges, never deploys)

## What & why

New users arriving with draft/outline/drop-zone intent hit `ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS` — a REGRESSION from `6b008f67` (R7HOME.2b): `GET /app` honors the §15.3 carried-file precedence by 302ing to `/app/new?entry=…`, but `GET /app/new` 302'd every document GET back to `/app`; the stored `signup_intent` persists so the pair ping-pongs forever (only `scratch` survived). The OAuth path didn't loop — it silently lost intent on the same bounce (`onUserCreate` never writes `signup_intent`). Both paths are repaired.

## The fix

- `GET /app/new?entry=draft|outline` (+`held`) serves the SPA shell (`SPA_DOCUMENT_ROUTES` already arms `/app/new`/`onboarding`) — the in-router leaf issues the ONE create POST and hands `held` to `/p/:slug/import`. Bare/other-entry GETs keep the server redirect.
- Consume-once: api `POST /showcase/intent/consume` clears `user.signup_intent` (self-scoped account-row write, idempotent, 401 unauthenticated); `GET /app` awaits it as it honors the redirect — a later `/app` never force-redirects, a refused create cannot re-loop.
- Leaf failure arm `href:` → `to:` — in-router `/app`, deploy-skew defense while any stored intent lingers.

## Evidence

- `apps/web/src/signup-redirect.test.ts` (19 tests) — **8 failed pre-fix / all pass post-fix**: every auth landing URL resolves 200 in ≤2 hops for Showcase-only AND own-project users; consume exactly once; non-handoff GETs still redirect.
- `apps/api/src/showcase.test.ts` — consume endpoint clears the column, idempotent, 401.
- `apps/web/src/spa/onboarding.dom.test.tsx` — refused create lands on the mounted `/app` leaf, zero doc-navs.
- `packages/journeys/src/signup-redirect.local.test.ts` — real-browser local arm (web dist + stub api + Chromium): real drop-zone hold → `/app?entry=draft&held=1` → ONE create + ONE consume → `/p/<slug>/import` hydrated → later `/app` lands the list.
- Suites: web 1689/1689 · api+client+journeys 858/858 · typecheck/lint clean · `check:dom-contract` OK.

## Deploy arm

Stage-A: **ready to deploy, awaiting operator merge.** Post-merge deploy is a separate act under `GD-HOTFIX.R6`: pre-state capture, rollback re-point, post-deploy N1/N3 + manual GET of the redirect chain.
